title: Degradation of Temminck's pangolin (Smutsia temminckii) scales with a keratinase for extraction of reproductive steroid hormones
author: Blecher, Scheun, et al.

steps.title: Clip scale pieces
steps.instruction: Using linesman pliers, cut each pangolin scale into pieces approximately 5 mm × 7 mm while the scales are held inside a clear plastic bag to prevent loss.

steps.title: Prepare keratinase solution
steps.instruction: Mix the keratinase enzyme Cibenza IND900 (Novus International, Inc.; EC 3.4.21; activity = 65,000 U/g, derived from Bacillus licheniformis fermentation solubles and sodium sulphate) with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) adjusted to pH 9.0, following the formulation described by Alba et al.

steps.title: Add samples to tubes
steps.instruction: Place the clipped scale pieces into individual test tubes, add 15 mL of the prepared keratinase solution to each tube, and cover the tube tops with aluminium foil.

steps.title: Incubate with periodic stirring
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes for four days in a LABEX PTY LTD JP SELECTAⓇ UNITRONIC‑OR shaking water bath, stirring approximately every 24 h either by plugging the tube top and inverting once or by stirring with a rod, and monitor for the appearance of white powder‑like material settling at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Terminate incubation and transfer
steps.instruction: After the four‑day incubation (or when no further liquidisation is observed), remove the tubes from the water bath, empty the entire contents of each tube into a 50 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Store extracts at -20°C
steps.instruction: Seal the centrifuge tubes and store them at –20 °C until hormone analysis is performed.
